name: Pipework
description: Wang tiles of pipe: elbows, straights, tees and crosses with rounded bends, each tile open only where its neighbor is, so the pipes join into one tangled network.

code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box; --po0: radial-gradient(circle farthest-side at 100% 0, transparent 33%, #000 33% 67%, transparent 67%); --po1: radial-gradient(circle farthest-side at 100% 100%, transparent 33%, #000 33% 67%, transparent 67%); --po2: radial-gradient(circle farthest-side at 0 100%, transparent 33%, #000 33% 67%, transparent 67%); --po3: radial-gradient(circle farthest-side at 0 0, transparent 33%, #000 33% 67%, transparent 67%); --po4: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 33%, #000 33% 67%, transparent 67%); --po5: linear-gradient(transparent 33%, #000 33% 67%, transparent 67%); --po6: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 33%, #000 33% 67%, transparent 67%) top / 100% 50% no-repeat; --po7: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 33%, #000 33% 67%, transparent 67%) bottom / 100% 50% no-repeat; --po8: linear-gradient(transparent 33%, #000 33% 67%, transparent 67%) left / 50% 100% no-repeat; --po9: linear-gradient(transparent 33%, #000 33% 67%, transparent 67%) right / 50% 100% no-repeat; --po10: radial-gradient(circle farthest-side, #000 34%, transparent 34%); --poe: linear-gradient(transparent, transparent); --pi0: radial-gradient(circle farthest-side at 100% 0, transparent 46%, #000 46% 54%, transparent 54%); --pi1: radial-gradient(circle farthest-side at 100% 100%, transparent 46%, #000 46% 54%, transparent 54%); --pi2: radial-gradient(circle farthest-side at 0 100%, transparent 46%, #000 46% 54%, transparent 54%); --pi3: radial-gradient(circle farthest-side at 0 0, transparent 46%, #000 46% 54%, transparent 54%); --pi4: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 46%, #000 46% 54%, transparent 54%); --pi5: linear-gradient(transparent 46%, #000 46% 54%, transparent 54%); --pi6: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 46%, #000 46% 54%, transparent 54%) top / 100% 50% no-repeat; --pi7: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 46%, #000 46% 54%, transparent 54%) bottom / 100% 50% no-repeat; --pi8: linear-gradient(transparent 46%, #000 46% 54%, transparent 54%) left / 50% 100% no-repeat; --pi9: linear-gradient(transparent 46%, #000 46% 54%, transparent 54%) right / 50% 100% no-repeat; --pi10: radial-gradient(circle farthest-side, #000 8%, transparent 8%); --pie: linear-gradient(transparent, transparent); } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
